purpose: Replicate published short-horizon cryptocurrency cross-sectional momentum on target-venue MEXC data without altering any existing frozen strategy protocol.

source_prior.citation: Drogen, Hoffstein, Otte, Cross-sectional Momentum in Cryptocurrency Markets
source_prior.published_signal: rank assets by trailing 30-day performance and hold winners for the next 7 days
source_prior.reported_evidence: top recent performers historically continued to outperform over the subsequent week; long-only momentum portfolios exceeded a Bitcoin benchmark in the study sample
source_prior.conflicting_evidence_note: later literature reports weak or absent cross-sectional momentum under more realistic assumptions, so this is a replication target rather than an accepted current edge

data.survivorship_warning: fixed current liquid panel is a development convenience and is not a historically reconstructed point-in-time universe

strategy.rebalance_rule: every 7 calendar observations after sufficient lookback

economics.cost_accounting: half the round-trip cost per unit of one-way portfolio turnover; changes from old to new weights incur both sells and buys
